The campus is the first CloudBurst Data Centers gigacenter, planned between San Marcos and New Braunfels in Central Texas. CloudBurst is a Denver firm founded in 2022. A Community Impact report from May 2025 puts the site on a 96-acre parcel off Francis Harris Lane that straddles Hays County and Guadalupe County. The full campus is planned at 1.2 GW, with a first 50 MW phase due online in the fourth quarter of 2026. A w.media article from November 2025 says a groundbreaking was held and that no tenant is named. Power would come from a behind-the-meter natural gas plant on site. Energy Transfer agreed to supply up to 450,000 million British thermal units per day for 10 years, and w.media says delivery is through the Oasis Pipeline. Community Impact and Data Center Dynamics say only that the gas comes through a pipeline running through the site. CloudBurst also plans a separate 200 MW site in Oklahoma.
